approvedCanonicalReplacements.before: Re-anchor the runtime/profile/policy/catalog identities under the approved mode change; no obsolete identity or image-provenance reuse.
approvedCanonicalReplacements.after: Re-anchor the runtime/profile/policy/catalog identities under the approved mode change; no obsolete identity or image-provenance reuse. For recorded observed replay, the same fixed persistent context may use one trusted startup page solely for chrome://version, chrome://prefs-internals and about:blank verification. At most one page is active at any instant. Before application navigation, source/blank-world evidence, browser secret delivery or action, run-origin sampling and Ready, close that page, await finalization and delete only its owned no-secret startup native video inside confined per-run scratch, then create the sole about:blank application page. Install phase-specific page guards from startup and the ordinary extra-application-page refusal before exposing the application page. Install the guard at first context acquisition with immediate reconciliation of the startup page set; authorize only the specifically issued application newPage operation after the startup page is closed and its artifact is deleted. Latch any unexpected-page event permanently for this launch, including events before the child subscribes; page replacement or late callback registration cannot clear or lose it. Refuse readiness on the latch even if the unexpected page was already closed. Unexpected pages, unsafe paths, failed or unbounded close/delete, missing effective preferences or confinement mismatch fail before Ready; no fallback or diagnostic video upload is permitted. On probe, video finalization/deletion, cancellation, deadline or context failure, refuse Ready and dispose the actual context/browser; late launch completion after stop is disposed too. The parent bounds or forces process-tree teardown and scratch/capacity release. Never swallow startup cleanup failure, choose a stray recording or wait indefinitely for native video. Parent/child start and absolute admission/run deadlines continue across every startup step and cleanup; neither page replacement nor clock sampling resets or extends them. Sample the existing paired wall/monotonic run origin once at clean application-page recording readiness, validate its blank world before Ready, and retain measured pinned-recorder seek calibration. Clean app-page readiness is established before the existing one-time paired origin sample and blank-world/liveness check before Ready. An application recording may have a measured bounded blank prefix; actual pinned native-recorder calibration must still meet the existing controlled-fixture seek target within 500 ms for initial navigation and failure. No diagnostic-prefix arithmetic or virtual timing result substitutes for decoded native video or outstanding staging calibration. Keep the existing admitted runtime budget/window and continuous absolute run/parent deadlines; do not grant a new runtime allowance on page replacement. Only this application page supplies native app video; no rewrite, merge, transcode, diagnostic-prefix subtraction or altered application recording is allowed. Native partial/evidence state remains determined by actual application recording finalization, independently of outcome. Guided unrecorded startup currently stays unchanged; OBS-013 must record the same sole clean application page in its existing guided context. This sequential trusted bootstrap exception does not permit popups, multi-page application workflows, extra contexts, browser modes, arguments, sandbox bypass, new wire fields or image-provenance waiver. Backend resolution may already precede launch; this rule makes no claim of zero backend Vault reads or releases during startup.
rationale: Prevent early unexpected-page blind window or dropped callback/latch during authorized page replacement.
Bind failure/cancel/late-launch/video cleanup to actual bounded teardown before Ready.
Do not imply removing diagnostic video alone proves origin/seek calibration or renews admitted runtime.
